data.name: ExtensionDescription
data.value: Generate MonoWeaver lambda HookPatterns from selected decompiled code.

data.name: AdvancedDescription
data.value: Choose a specific sub-expression or IL anchor. By default, the pattern covering the complete selection is used.

data.name: StatusUnique
data.value: The generated pattern uniquely matches the selected code.

data.name: StatusAmbiguous
data.value: Warning: this pattern matches {0} locations. Use Advanced IL matching to refine it.

data.name: NoSuggestions
data.value: MonoWeaver could not express the selected code as a Value, Effect, or Condition pattern.

data.name: ModuleUnsaved
data.value: The selected module has no saved file. Save it before generating a HookPattern.

data.name: ModuleMismatch
data.value: The module loaded by dnSpy differs from the file on disk (MVID mismatch). Save or reload the module first.

data.name: MethodResolveFailed
data.value: Could not resolve method token {0} in the saved module.

data.name: NoIlMapping
data.value: The selected source code did not map to any CIL instructions.

data.name: SelectionExceedsSinglePattern
data.value: The selected IL contains multiple semantic roots and cannot be represented by one Value, Effect, or Condition Pattern. Narrow the selection or generate separate hooks.
